title: Season 1: The Festival of Equal Night
missedDayRule: Real calendar dates unlock content and never expire. Players may replay any earlier date in the current month. Every Sunday pays off that week's trouble; the final date is the Great Event.

fantasyMonths.name: MUDWAKE
fantasyMonths.threat: the roads have become sentient mud

fantasyMonths.name: JESTERFALL
fantasyMonths.threat: a prophecy insists the village is the joke

fantasyMonths.name: SUNFINE
fantasyMonths.threat: daylight is charging by the hour

fantasyMonths.name: EELTIDE
fantasyMonths.threat: the river intends to flow uphill

fantasyMonths.name: OGREWATCH
fantasyMonths.threat: an ogre is collecting the village one course at a time

fantasyMonths.name: GOURDFEAR
fantasyMonths.threat: the pumpkins know everyone's true name

fantasyMonths.name: YULEDEBT
fantasyMonths.threat: the Yule Beast has itemised joy

sundayClimaxes.title: THE BELLS DECLARE AN EMERGENCY
sundayClimaxes.plot: The week's rumours become official when every bell rings a different catastrophe.
sundayClimaxes.hint: Above the village, south of thunder and directly beneath panic.
sundayClimaxes.precursor: Every unresolved sign from Monday to Saturday is read aloud by the wrong bell.
sundayClimaxes.consequence: The first threat is named and the village prepares for a worse one.

sundayClimaxes.title: THE GOLDEN POTATO VANISHES
sundayClimaxes.plot: The week's thefts lead to a painted turnip where the Golden Potato stood.
sundayClimaxes.hint: East through the marsh, beyond the reeds wearing stolen gold leaf.
sundayClimaxes.precursor: Six days of missing stores and oversized fingerprints point to the display hall.
sundayClimaxes.consequence: The outer gates close and the catastrophe gains a suspect.

sundayClimaxes.title: THE OGRE INVASION
sundayClimaxes.plot: All week's footprints, smoke and stolen provisions arrive together at East Gate.
sundayClimaxes.hint: At the eastern breach, west of the ogre and east of everyone sensible.
sundayClimaxes.precursor: The warnings were correct, which the council finds deeply inconvenient.
sundayClimaxes.consequence: The ogre falls and reveals who paid for the invasion.

sundayClimaxes.title: THE PROCESSION OF CONSEQUENCES
sundayClimaxes.plot: Every repaired landmark and offended witness from the week joins one dangerous procession.
sundayClimaxes.hint: From East Gate to the well, along the road that remembers everything.
sundayClimaxes.precursor: The month's scattered quests finally form a route through the village.
sundayClimaxes.consequence: The full cast assembles and the Great Event becomes unavoidable.

sundayClimaxes.title: THE LAST SUNDAY OMEN
sundayClimaxes.plot: An extra Sunday appears in the accounts and demands an additional catastrophe.
sundayClimaxes.hint: Under Castle Moon, between the fifth bell and the end of the page.
sundayClimaxes.precursor: The calendar has more Sundays than the prophecy budget allowed.
sundayClimaxes.consequence: The final secret needed for the Great Event is recovered.

questTypes.name: Parley
questTypes.play: Follow testimony between named characters; no combat required until the trail turns dangerous.

questTypes.name: Recovery
questTypes.play: Enter a named biome, retrieve one relic and return it to a character who changes the situation.

questTypes.name: Monster Hunt
questTypes.play: Track signs to a lair, defeat one named foe and carry proof back.

questTypes.name: Delve
questTypes.play: Open a wilderness gate, cross a compact rogue space, survive traps and recover a relic.

questTypes.name: Warding
questTypes.play: Visit threatened sites, recover a focus and defeat the creature breaking the ward.

questTypes.name: Village Defence
questTypes.play: Read the warning signs, prepare a gate and defeat the invader at the breach.

weeks.title: Rumours and Petty Omens
weeks.worldChange: Small absurdities establish the festival and the month's threat.

weeks.title: Evidence and Missing Food
weeks.worldChange: Relics vanish, witnesses disagree and the threat leaves physical evidence.

weeks.title: Gates and Large Footprints
weeks.worldChange: The catastrophe becomes undeniable and reaches the village.

weeks.title: Consequences in Procession
weeks.worldChange: The full cast repairs damage and exposes the hand behind the threat.

weeks.title: The Unbudgeted Week
weeks.worldChange: Any remaining dates reveal the final requirement for the Great Event.

days.title: THE FIRST COUNT
days.plot: The Tollbooth Clerk begins the festival count; the Rat King disputes the number of doors.
days.hint: At the well, east of the inn and south of arithmetic.
days.precursor: Juniper reports a northern road entry written in unusually large handwriting.
days.consequence: Counting posts appear around the village.

days.title: JUNIPER TAKES THE LONG WAY
days.plot: Juniper followed an impossible footprint into Crumbly Wood and failed to return for breakfast.
days.hint: West of the gate, beneath the oak marked with a ranger's blunt arrow.
days.precursor: Juniper claimed the heavy tracks were heading north while pointing firmly west.
days.consequence: Juniper marks the safe road with arrows that mostly agree.

days.title: LIVESTOCK BEHIND THE WALLS
days.plot: The castle doors have been counted as livestock and demand winter feed.
days.hint: Inside Castle Moon, north of the gate and beneath legal masonry.
days.precursor: Moon saw a broad shadow cross the northern battlements.
days.consequence: Castle doors receive small census tags.

days.title: A CENSUS OF MOONLIGHT
days.plot: The Weather Clerk must weigh moonlight before it touches the festival scales.
days.hint: North of the village, where the moor keeps no receipts.
days.precursor: The Mole Prophet reports that something enormous has blocked a tunnel.
days.consequence: Moon marks appear on the northern standing stones.

days.title: THE CHALK MINE
days.plot: The festival has exhausted its chalk; the old barrow seam must be reopened.
days.hint: South of the village, under the hill with the least convincing grave.
days.precursor: The Gravedigger finds a cooking pot too large to bury.
days.consequence: Fresh chalk arrows point toward every gate.

days.title: THE NORTHERN MILESTONE
days.plot: A northern milestone has been bitten clean through at shoulder height.
days.hint: Beyond North Gate, east of the stone that now says only MILES.
days.precursor: The bite is far above any goblin's reach.
days.consequence: The road is marked unsafe for unusually tall traffic.

days.title: THE BELL UNDER THE HILL
days.plot: The festival bell rings underground before anyone pulls it.
days.hint: In the South Barrows, below regret and one layer of turf.
days.precursor: Its final toll is answered by a distant roar.
days.consequence: Week One ends with the first public warning.

days.title: LANTERNS FOR THE FORD
days.plot: The eastern ford must be lit before festival traders arrive.
days.hint: East of the gate, where River Regret forgets to be a bridge.
days.precursor: The Eel Bailiff finds wagon tracks twice the width of the ford.
days.consequence: Lantern posts light the marsh road.

days.title: THE DRESS ONION
days.plot: The official dress onion must be approved by both crown and moon.
days.hint: At the market, west of the well and under excessive lace.
days.precursor: The Onion Merchant has sold every practical onion to a northern buyer.
days.consequence: The village adopts an edible dress code.

days.title: A TROLL AT SUPPER
days.plot: The Bridge Troll refuses tolls until invited to festival supper.
days.hint: At East Ford, beneath the bridge and above the soup line.
days.precursor: The troll describes a huge customer asking which gate tastes best.
days.consequence: The bridge opens and gains a reserved supper place.

days.title: BRAMBLE REFUSES LUNCH
days.plot: Bramble will not eat until the whispering picnic is exorcised.
days.hint: West of the village, north of the mushroom with documentary evidence.
days.precursor: The Hedge Witch hears trees snapping far beyond the picnic.
days.consequence: Bramble joins the festival repair crew.

days.title: THE EMPTY GRANARY
days.plot: Three weeks of grain vanish without a broken lock.
days.hint: North of the village, where the granary casts a hungry shadow.
days.precursor: The missing sacks leave a trail of enormous crumbs eastward.
days.consequence: Food is moved inside the central village.

days.title: GUARD THE GOLDEN POTATO
days.plot: The Golden Potato is displayed while every faction argues over its guard rota.
days.hint: In the counting hall, south of the well and beneath royal suspicion.
days.precursor: A huge fingerprint is found on the display glass.
days.consequence: The Potato receives two guards and no useful protection.

days.title: THE GOLDEN POTATO VANISHES
days.plot: The display contains a painted turnip; the real Golden Potato is gone.
days.hint: East through the marsh, beyond the reeds wearing stolen gold leaf.
days.precursor: The thief's trail is crossed by much larger bare footprints.
days.consequence: Festival guards close the outer gates at dusk.

days.title: A FOOTPRINT IN THE BARROWS
days.plot: A single footprint has crushed three respectable graves.
days.hint: South of the village, where the hill now has a heel mark.
days.precursor: The print belongs to an ogre walking east.
days.consequence: An ogre warning is nailed to every gate.

days.title: THREE SHEEP AND A HELMET
days.plot: Three sheep and one guard helmet disappear from the northern pasture.
days.hint: Beyond North Gate, west of the weather that refuses to testify.
days.precursor: The helmet carries an ogre tooth mark.
days.consequence: Livestock moves inside the village walls.

days.title: THE BENT BRIDGE
days.plot: The East Bridge bends downward after one unseen crossing.
days.hint: East of the gate, above River Regret and below structural confidence.
days.precursor: Bramble estimates the traveller weighed one ogre and a packed lunch.
days.consequence: The bridge is braced for one final crossing.

days.title: SMOKE BEYOND THE EAST GATE
days.plot: A cooking fire appears beyond the eastern reeds each night.
days.hint: East of the ford, where the smoke smells of pepper and stolen grain.
days.precursor: The Soup Oracle identifies a pot large enough to cook the village bell.
days.consequence: A watch is posted at East Gate.

days.title: THE OGRE'S SHOPPING LIST
days.plot: A list requests grain, onions, one golden potato and a village small enough to carry.
days.hint: West of the village, pinned to a tree at ogre eye height.
days.precursor: The final line reads ARRIVE ON EQUAL NIGHT REHEARSAL.
days.consequence: The invasion date becomes known.

days.title: CLOSE THE VILLAGE GATES
days.plot: The cast repairs four gates and discovers the East Gate chain has been cut.
days.hint: At East Gate, beyond the well and before the smoke.
days.precursor: The warning bell is moved to the gatehouse.
days.consequence: All outer routes close except the defended East Gate.

days.title: THE OGRE INVASION
days.plot: The ogre reaches East Gate for the Golden Potato and the village itself.
days.hint: At the eastern breach, west of the ogre and east of everyone sensible.
days.precursor: Six days of evidence finally become one very large enemy.
days.consequence: The ogre falls; the damaged gate becomes part of the festival procession route.

days.title: JUNIPER RETURNS WITH PROOF
days.plot: Juniper returns with a map of the Potato thieves' route and three witnesses who disagree with north.
days.hint: At West Gate, carrying a bent bow and a map corrected in several colours.
days.precursor: Juniper saw the Potato thieves hiding during the invasion.
days.consequence: The thieves' route is marked for the festival watch.

days.title: THE FALSE POTATO
days.plot: The festival must prove that the display vegetable was a turnip in disguise.
days.hint: At the market, between the onions and the witness who boils everything.
days.precursor: Gold paint matches flakes found in the eastern marsh.
days.consequence: The Turnip Widow becomes an official witness.

days.title: THE TAX WEASEL'S PRICE
days.plot: The Tax Weasel knows the thieves' route but demands one impossible deduction.
days.hint: North of the village, inside the audit hut with no visible door.
days.precursor: The ledger names a hidden store beneath Castle Moon.
days.consequence: The route to the stolen Potato is marked.

days.title: RECORDS OF EQUAL NIGHT
days.plot: Keith opens the castle archive to find the original rules of Equal Night.
days.hint: Inside Castle Moon, below the stair that only exists at dusk.
days.precursor: The charter says the scales require both the Golden Potato and Black Turnip.
days.consequence: The finale's true requirements are revealed.

days.title: THE GOLDEN POTATO RECOVERED
days.plot: The cast descends beneath Castle Moon and recovers the stolen Golden Potato.
days.hint: Below the castle, east of daylight and north of the claimant's lair.
days.precursor: The claimant admits the Ogre was paid to distract the village.
days.consequence: The Golden Potato returns to the procession.

days.title: THE PROCESSION ROAD
days.plot: The invasion-damaged road must be warded before day and night walk it together.
days.hint: From East Gate to the well, along the road that still remembers the ogre.
days.precursor: Every repaired landmark from the season becomes part of the route.
days.consequence: The full cast assembles for Equal Night.

days.title: THE AUTUMN EQUINOX
days.plot: The Golden Potato and Black Turnip must balance the scales while the cast holds back the Unbalanced Shadow.
days.hint: At the village well, between dawn and dusk and immediately before supper.
days.precursor: Four weeks of repairs, testimony and recovered relics converge.
days.consequence: Equal Night is completed, unless the real calendar has further objections.

days.title: THE SPARE OMEN
days.plot: The month contains a day the official prophecy failed to mention.
days.hint: North of the village, after the forecast and before the margin.
days.precursor: The Weather Clerk discovers tomorrow written on the back of yesterday.
days.consequence: The spare omen identifies the final threat's hiding place.

days.title: THE LAST FESTIVAL PERMIT
days.plot: The Great Event cannot legally occur until its missing permit is recovered.
days.hint: Inside Castle Moon, filed east of reason and north of closing time.
days.precursor: Every catastrophe is ready except the paperwork authorising it.
days.consequence: The Great Event receives regrettable legal permission.

days.title: THE CALENDAR BITES BACK
days.plot: The month's extra date climbs from the ledger and demands to be celebrated.
days.hint: In the South Barrows, beneath the page nobody turned.
days.precursor: All unused omens gather in one final square of the calendar.
days.consequence: The month ends and its catastrophes become replayable history.

stagePattern: recover relic or defeat named foe
return to a different cast member
